exact_statement: For every integer n>=2 let F_n be the uniform Boolean sign on n+1 bits which is negative exactly at integer vertices 0,1,3; query least-significant bit j. Its squared Fourier law has full support, both physical children are nonconstant, Inf_j=2^-n, I=(3n-1)2^-n and H<=8I. Starting with matching complete root reference Q=P_F and giving both children the inherited marginal q, the conditional occupancy refund is exactly zero. On the j=0 point-defect child let a={y1}, t=2^-n, q_a=2t^2, q_0=1-6t+10t^2, p_0=(1-2t)^2 and M=2^(2n-2). Replace only q(a) by q(a)2^-M and add the removed mass to q(empty); leave the other terminal and already booked erasure unchanged. The new reference has full support and total variation <2^(1-2n), but its physically weighted signed complete reset bill is Z_n=[1-p_0 log2(1+q_a(1-2^-M)/q_0)]/2>3/8, with Z_n->1/2. Thus Z_n/Inf_j->infinity and no dimension-independent absolute-TV tolerance alone certifies an O(I) same-account reset. The first member has dimension three, minimal for full root support and two nonconstant children. This refutes an absolute-TV reset surrogate, not A099 exact RS2 or FEI. A multiplicative bound qtilde>=(1-eta)q on occupied atoms instead gives reset increase <=-log2(1-eta), for 0<=eta<1.

refutes: Absolute total-variation proximity alone uniformly preserves O(I) complete-reference reset costs, even on full-support matching roots with two nonconstant children
